name: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed in most of the Long Beach Unit, but never on the West Coast Trail or the Broken Group Islands.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed in most of the Long Beach Unit, but never on the West Coast Trail or the Broken Group Islands.

excerpts.quote: In areas where dogs are permitted (outside designated closures), they must be kept close and on a leash at all times, including on beaches, trails, parking lots, and in the water.
Dogs are not permitted in the West Coast Trail Unit or the Broken Group Islands Unit at any time, unless they are certified service pets.

dogRules.text: No dogs in the West Coast Trail Unit or the Broken Group Islands Unit.

Wolf warning: dogs are banned on the coast and trails between Green Point Rocks and Willowbrae Trail until further notice; Wickaninnish Dunes and the Old Gold Mine Trail are closed to people and dogs.
April 1 to October 1: no dogs between Sandhill Creek and Green Point Rocks, including Combers Beach, its trail and the Green Point Campground boardwalk.
Stay 25 m from shorebirds; penalties reach $25,000.
